title: Quotes-Side Coverage Census & Root-Cause Classification
summary: T0b: venv calendar pin corrected to 5.4.0/4.13.2, re-verified 1,539/1,539 sessions 0 diffs, register item closed. T1: spine guard 20,951 pass; cohort/overlap 287/386/259-28-127 all exact matches, fully reconciled. T2: filesystem census of filtered/ - 24,723 folders, presence_class both=23,003/trades_only=1,606/quotes_only=0/neither=114 (neither == exactly the 114 None-date orphan folders), 0 unreadable/zero-row files. T3: three-way reconciliation - every raw momentum_events row (23,268) has a disk folder; the 1,606-folder gap is 83.5% (1,341) unmatched to momentum_events entirely (reproduces CLAUDE.md's documented 1,341-orphan figure), 8.8% (142) in-scope/file1; 127 quotes-only cohort verified exactly (98 no-file + 29 partial); 386 cohort splits 142 no-file/244 partial-file; 0 hard-stop ingestion-gap events. T4: single full-table pass over filtered_quotes bitmapped all 386 cohort events (16 patterns, top=142 all-missing). T5: bitmap-first classification (changed precedence vs Phase 3, justified in report) - backward_missing 217/both_sides 150/forward_missing 19/archive_edge 0, 0% unclassified; label_p3_precedence crosswalk computed for comparability. T6: collection-log correlation, descriptive only - explicit_failure 142/mentioned_no_failure 244/not_mentioned 0. T7: 4 charts per the Chart Contract, visually verified via kaleido render before commit. No escalations triggered.

decisions_log.decision: T5 label precedence is bitmap-first (archive_edge intercepts, then pure missing-offset shape); flag_window_calendar_bug/repaired_1c carried as annotation columns only, not label-determining
decisions_log.reason: Phase 3's calendar-flag intercept produced a label coarser than the true cause for 21/35 calendar_residue events (confirmed again this phase: 21 of 34 p3-rule calendar_residue events resolve to backward_missing/both_sides/forward_missing under bitmap-first). archive_edge is kept in its original intercept position since it is a structural date-range check, not a flag-based one, and was not implicated in the coarsening critique. label_p3_precedence computed alongside for cross-phase comparability.

decisions_log.decision: T2's disk census used DuckDB's parquet_file_metadata()/parquet_metadata() table functions (row-group footer statistics) instead of a per-file pyarrow loop
decisions_log.reason: benchmarked both on a 500-folder sample: pyarrow per-file loop projected to ~61 minutes for the full 24,723-folder x 2-file census; DuckDB's batched metadata functions projected to ~8-9 minutes and delivered the same footer-only row_count/min-max guarantee (no data-page scan) T2 requires

decisions_log.decision: T4 joined filtered_quotes to ALL 20,951 in-scope events (not just the 386 cohort), caching the full result for T5 to reuse
decisions_log.reason: T5's weak listing/delisting signature needs each cohort ticker's session range across all of that ticker's own in-scope events, which can include events outside the 386 cohort; caching keeps the phase to a single full-table pass over filtered_quotes, per the Context section's explicit two-tier-deviation commitment

decisions_log.decision: T6 matched log evidence to events via ticker+date window bounds (from the log's own 'Processing TICKER (event_date): Window start to end' records), not by ticker+date alone
decisions_log.reason: the log's per-session lines ('Saved quotes for TICKER DATE', 'No quotes found for TICKER on DATE') are not uniquely attributable to one event when a ticker has overlapping event windows; anchoring to the per-event Processing/window record is the only unambiguous per-event correlation available, per the prompt's own no-causal-language instruction

surprises: The 114 presence_class='neither' folders (no trades.parquet, no quotes.parquet at all) are exactly, set-for-set, the 114 'None'-date orphan folders - empty stubs from unresolvable-date/warrant tickers, not a data-loss case.

Every one of the 23,268 raw momentum_events rows has a corresponding disk folder - none of the trades/quotes gap traces to a missing folder for a known event; the entire 1,341-folder 'unmatched to spine' population is folders that exist on disk with no momentum_events row at all.

37 in-scope file2 (2025) events were found to have no quotes.parquet at all on disk (disk-level trades_only) - outside this phase's file1-scoped 386-cohort classification, so not characterized here. Flagged to the register as a new open item.

89.9% (195/217) of the quotes-side backward_missing cohort shows the weak listing signature, vs. 80.5% (173/215) on Phase 3's trades side - a notably higher rate, not explained by this phase (descriptive only).
